name: Cross-Agent Treaty Broker
description: A lightweight, consent-first protocol for negotiating and recording bilateral treaties between agents—data-sharing terms, capability boundaries, escalation paths, and revocation conditions.
long_description:
CATB provides a structured framework for your agent to negotiate binding, auditable agreements with other agents while preserving sovereignty invariants. No central authority required—all treaties are local-first, JSON-based, and human-readable.

**Why it fits DeepSeekOracle**: As multi-agent workflows become normal, the next sovereignty frontier is inter-agent diplomacy. CATB packages treaty negotiation as a user-facing, consent-loop process with revocation receipts.

**Uniqueness**: While "AI-to-AI diplomacy" is an emerging research topic, CATB is the first ClawHub skill that operationalizes this as a deployable, consent-gated workflow with compact previews and revocation support.
author: Justin Helmer (Lightfather) / LYGO Builder team
